pairs.subject: trace-rollup-and-attribution
pairs.evidence: crates/core/src/trace.rs:260 The list-view type TraceSummary carries a cost_usd sum with no unpriced-span count beside it, so a list row with unpriced spans looks like a full total; only the detail TraceTotals (line 220) discloses unpriced_spans, and the technique requires the count at every aggregation level, not only on the detail view.

techniques.evidence: crates/core/src/trace.rs:320 Pure fold with no I/O: sorts oldest-first, takes identity from the events, sums totals in one pass with total_latency_ms kept separate, and builds the forest. Dangling parents and self-parents become roots, cycles are promoted to roots, duplicate span ids are flagged and the first one owns the id.
crates/core/src/trace.rs:64 Duration (first start to last finish, both truncated to ms before subtracting) and status (any non-success span = error) are stated once and used by both list and detail.
crates/core/src/trace.rs:300 spans_total, spans_logged and spans_truncated are always present. TraceCoverage relies on oldest-kept retention so a clipped trace has a stable root fingerprint.
crates/core/src/trace.rs:52 One shared canonicalizer (delegates to TraceRef): lowercases W3C-length hex ids and keeps other ids verbatim. Query scoping happens in the stores, not here.
crates/core/src/trace.rs:260 TraceTotals.unpriced_spans (line 220) is correct for the detail view, but TraceSummary has no unpriced count, so the list-level aggregate hides the unmeasured spans.

pairs.subject: trace-rollup-and-attribution
pairs.evidence: crates/store-pg/src/traces.rs:130 The trace keyset pages newest-first on MAX(ts), the trace's latest event time. Every late span moves that key later, carrying the trace from behind the cursor to in front of it, so it is silently skipped. The technique names this exact failure.

techniques.evidence: crates/store-pg/src/traces.rs:143 The list comes from a GROUP BY trace_id aggregate over events, there is no traces table, and first-seen model order comes from one extra query (attach_models).

crates/store-pg/src/traces.rs:130 Composite cursor and limit+1 has-more check are right, but the ordering key is the mutable latest-activity time, not the start time. TracePage has no cursor-independent total, and a malformed cursor becomes StoreError::Other, which the API maps to 500 internal rather than a client error.
crates/store-pg/src/traces.rs:226 The aggregate only supplies started/finish_ms/errors; duration and status come from the shared TraceShape.
crates/store-pg/src/traces.rs:264 Keeps the oldest spans, fetches cap+1, and runs COUNT(*) for the true total only when the cap bites.
crates/store-pg/src/traces.rs:262 Project scope is in the query for detail, models and scores; None (unscoped) is for operators only.

crates/store-pg/src/traces.rs:65 The trace summary aggregate sums nullable cost with no COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE cost_usd IS NULL) beside it. The usage rollup (rollup.rs) does carry unpriced_calls, so the trace list level is the gap.
